summary: Frontend-only E2E for the editor autosave/reset/action-flush/mobile-nav requirements. All 13 scenarios passed on preview URL. Verified: (1) clean load leaves save-status data-state='idle' with zero autosave PUTs and no draft-restore prompt; (2) typing into [data-field=bill_to_name] inside [data-testid=document-canvas] is NOT reverted while typing, cycles dirty->saving->saved and shows 'Saved · just now'; (3) refresh persists typed content; (4) add-line-item + qty/rate edits + discount-toggle + tax-toggle + currency-select (USD) + page-size-select (US Letter) + doc-theme-toggle all autosave and survive reload; (5) status-select change made immediately after typing persists to 'Sent' with NO false conflict-dialog (ensureSaved() flushes pending edits first); (6) more-menu > duplicate-doc right after typing produces a new doc whose canvas contains the just-typed suffix; (7) share-button opens dialog with share-link-input containing /share/<token>; (8) more-menu > convert-doc (quotation->invoice) carries just-typed text into the new invoice; (9) more-menu > mark-paid on an invoice navigates to a doc of type 'receipt'; (10) reset-dialog: reset-defaults preserves doc-number, clears bill_to_name and shows Undo toast button (10s); reset-blank clears the field; second-confirm step (reset-confirm-again) correctly appears for sent/paid docs; (11) delete-doc opens AlertDialog [data-testid=delete-dialog] (no window.confirm) and delete-confirm navigates to /documents; (12) Dashboard shows separate '€' breakdown under Outstanding when an unpaid EUR invoice exists (currencies NOT summed); (13) mobile 390px: mobile-nav-button opens mobile-nav sheet, navigation works, no horizontal page overflow. Regression: /documents, /clients, /settings all load; PrintButton present on editor.
critical_code_review_comments: DocumentCanvas.Editable sets innerHTML once via useLayoutEffect and relies on canvasKey remount to replace content from server/reset. This is the correct fix for React 19 wiping typed text; combined with the no-remount PUT response merge in doSave (setDoc without bumping canvasKey) it correctly preserves caret while syncing updated_at. Verified end-to-end.

lastKeyRef baseline is captured in a setTimeout(0) after canvasKey change — if a user types within that microtask window the first keystroke could seed the baseline and be lost from autosave. In practice unobservable (debounce is 1500ms), but worth noting.
Prior-iteration note still stands: GET /api/auth/me returns raw '_id' instead of a renamed 'id'. Non-blocking.
seed_data_creation: Created a handful of throw-away docs during the run (TEST_ACME/invoice, quotation, EUR invoice, receipt-from-mark-paid, duplicate) and deleted all of them via DELETE /api/documents/{id} at the end of each test block.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Autosave debounce is 1500ms — after any edit wait >=1800ms before asserting data-state='saved'. Use page.wait_for_function on [data-testid=save-status][data-state] attribute rather than inner_text (label 'Saved · just now' only renders after at). The canvas-level inputs are plain contentEditable spans/divs with data-field attributes inside [data-testid=document-canvas]; use Control+A then keyboard.type to replace text (do NOT use page.fill — they are not form inputs). To create docs quickly from the UI session use page.evaluate(fetch('/api/documents', {credentials:'include'})). Reset-defaults button on a sent/paid doc requires clicking reset-confirm-again second. Dashboard EUR breakdown appears as sub-text under the Outstanding Stat card (format: '+ €500.00').
rca of the issue: No bugs reproduced. The owner's original complaint (editor losing data on refresh / saves wiping fields) is fully resolved: DocumentCanvas.Editable now mounts innerHTML once and remounts only on canvasKey change (fixing React 19 render-time innerHTML reset); DocumentEditor's doSave merges the server response without bumping canvasKey; empty-overwrite guard in buildPayload/collect prevents a save with zero data-field elements; ensureSaved() flushes before every action (status, share, duplicate, convert, mark-paid, docx) so action buttons never race with the 1.5s debounce; lastKeyRef baseline prevents false autosave PUTs on load/remount; keepalive save on hide/unload backs up by localStorage draft.
